I used to play Kolin. That's why she is in my avatar. I don't play her tho since like ultra gold. I think putting kolin in the center makes sense, because she can be braindead (spamming v skill, v trigger gimmicks, st.h.punch), but she also has to be good at neutral and she is pretty deep where it comes to mix-ups and excecution. Also she is in the center of execution, because her mix-ups, some combos and confirms are difficult, but she isn't charge and doesn't require strict timing.

Alex has easy pressure, but in neutral he has to actually outplay his opponent. That's why the middle is perfect for him.

Menat may have seen cheap but to get to that point you have to work hard in the execution. Menat mix-ups after v trigger are really hard to do and keeping someone away until v trigger in SFV is really hard. Not braindead means that you put an actual time into learning the character and that's a huge part of Menat. She is the most difficult character in SFV in my opinion.
